author: Zephyr I
title: Grouped 2-head attention (gated-sum) on LN-gated ConvLSTM (64ch)
abstract: Test a 2-head attention variant with grouped channel halves and learned per-head gates to aggregate contexts (gated sum). Keeps LN-gated ConvLSTM (64ch), default PG, and budget.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_ln_mha_grouped import CNNConvLSTMLN_Grouped2HAttn_GatedSum
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTMLN_Grouped2HAttn_GatedSum(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )
